_doc: Mana (PLAN M6, §0.11). Every number the mana system reads. Mana is kept per base (planet-specific): the HQ holds the store. `store.cap` is the HQ's own capacity; every battery adds `battery.capByLevel[global battery level]`. Mana comes back by itself at `regenPerSecond`, but only while the store is under `regenShare` of the cap; above that it must be REFINED from mana crystal (harvester -> porters -> mana refinery inside the HQ yard ring -> the store). Spell tiers open by cap: a spell of tier N can be armed once the cap reaches `tiers[N-1].cap`. `arm.ticks` = how long the key takes to turn itself after you pull a cartridge (20 ticks a second). Glow is the quarter-res field enemies that hunt magic follow; M4 owns the field and rebuilds it from sources: a spell that lands leaves a pulse of level `glow.spellBase` + `glow.perMana` x its cost for `glow.spellTicks`; a working refinery is a steady source of `refineryLevel`, a battery of `batteryLevel` (more when the store is fuller). Crystal clusters grow back one step per `crystal.regrowEvery` ticks (`crystal.regrowTries` cells tried) as long as at least one crystal cell is left; a cluster that was stripped bare never comes back.

battery._doc: One battery kind with a global level (§0.5). A battery that is destroyed (not pulled down) bursts: radius = r0 + perRoot x sqrt(charge it held), capped at rMax; power likewise. Pulled down, its crew bleeds it safely and the mana above the new cap is lost.

glow._fallback: decay / refinery / battery / *R are used only in a sim with no defence module (M4 owns and rebuilds the field; M6 hands it pulses and steady sources)

arm._doc: the key turns itself in half a second after you pull a cartridge

crafting._doc: Mana crystal is also a crafting input (owner: magical energy sources and empowered units). M6 provides the hooks; the rows land in M12 (PLAN). `sim.mana.spend(n, why)` takes mana from the store for an empowered unit or a ward; any recipe may list `crystal` as an input (the dispatcher already hauls it); a building with `power.fuel: { crystal: n }` is a crystal-burning power source with no new code (js/sim/economy/production.js powers it).

planned.what: a power source that burns mana crystal
a refined crystal part for empowered towers and units
an empowered unit that draws mana from the HQ store
